name: ringcentral-ace
description: ACE provides complete visibility into customer calls, meetings, and digital interactions. Managers can compare agent performance and turn quality metrics into targeted, evidence-based coaching backed by real interaction data. Executives gain clear foresight into key trends, competitor activity, churn risks, and customer satisfaction across all conversations.

interface.longDescription: ACE provides complete visibility into customer calls, meetings, and digital interactions. Managers can compare agent performance and turn quality metrics into targeted, evidence-based coaching backed by real interaction data. Executives gain clear foresight into key trends, competitor activity, churn risks, and customer satisfaction across all conversations.
defaultPrompt: Find an agent's recent recorded calls and extract the key questions asked and next steps.
Analyze customer satisfaction drivers and summarize the main topics from recent calls.
Which tracked customer issues rose most this week vs. last week? Show daily counts, percentage changes, and example calls.
